title.en: One window only: Diesel 40 or the tractor 4100 when power is absent
title.zh: 只留一个窗口：没有电源时，选柴油40还是拖拉机4100

description.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Use the 4100 when the published rural window fits: 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, 40–100 m horizontal / 15–45 m vertical, aggregate 1–3 cm, slump 180–220 mm and 1300 kg. Taken from the printed row: Use Diesel 40 when the off-grid line needs 26 m³/h and 120 m / 360 m on a 66 kW, 2800 kg trailer. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints both for sites without a pump-motor grid. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. They are not two names for one machine.
description.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：农村窗口对得上时用 4100：40 kW、6–12 m³/h、15 MPa、水平 40–100 m / 垂直 15–45 m、骨料 1–3 cm、坍落度 180–220 mm、1300 kg。无电网管路需要 26 m³/h 和 120 m / 360 m 时，用 66 kW、2800 kg 的柴油40拖泵。邢台河北品锦机械把两台都印给没有泵用电网的现场。它们不是一台机器的两个名字。

h1.en: One window only: Diesel 40 or the tractor 4100 when power is absent
h1.zh: 只留一个窗口：没有电源时，选柴油40还是拖拉机4100

directAnswer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Use the 4100 when the published rural window fits: 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, 40–100 m horizontal / 15–45 m vertical, aggregate 1–3 cm, slump 180–220 mm and 1300 kg. Taken from the printed row: Use Diesel 40 when the off-grid line needs 26 m³/h and 120 m / 360 m on a 66 kW, 2800 kg trailer. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints both for sites without a pump-motor grid. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. They are not two names for one machine.
directAnswer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：农村窗口对得上时用 4100：40 kW、6–12 m³/h、15 MPa、水平 40–100 m / 垂直 15–45 m、骨料 1–3 cm、坍落度 180–220 mm、1300 kg。无电网管路需要 26 m³/h 和 120 m / 360 m 时，用 66 kW、2800 kg 的柴油40拖泵。邢台河北品锦机械把两台都印给没有泵用电网的现场。它们不是一台机器的两个名字。

body.en: Borrow “Diesel generator set” from “Diesel generator” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Read it in the Xingtai table. Diesel 40 is the 66 kW trailer at 26 m³/h and 120 m / 360 m. Taken from the printed row: They are not two names for one machine. Keep this cell as published. The Diesel 40 introduction pairs 120 m / 360 m with 1 cm aggregate and does not add a maximum-aggregate specification cell. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Read it in the Xingtai table. Diesel 40 prints 25 MPa. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diesel_generator
body.zh: 把《Diesel generator》的“柴油发电机组”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。按邢台表上的原文理解：柴油40是 66 kW 拖泵，26 m³/h、120 m / 360 m。4100 是 40 kW 拖拉机带动的农村机，6–12 m³/h、1300 kg。目录里已经写着：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diesel_generator

body.en: The reference page “Diesel generator” uses “Generator size” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. Taken from the printed row: The 4100 is the 40 kW tractor-driven rural unit at 6–12 m³/h and 1300 kg. Keep this cell as published. The 4100 table labels power as 40 kW and describes a tractor-driven pump for rural houses. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The 4100 does print 1–3 cm. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. Taken from the printed row: /solutions/industrial-projects names Diesel 30–120 and the tractor-driven 4100.
body.zh: 来源页《Diesel generator》用“发电机粒径”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。农村窗口对得上时用 4100：40 kW、6–12 m³/h、15 MPa、水平 40–100 m / 垂直 15–45 m、骨料 1–3 cm、坍落度 180–220 mm、1300 kg。无电网管路需要 26 m³/h 和 120 m / 360 m 时，用 66 kW、2800 kg 的柴油40拖泵。河北品锦机械（邢台）把两台都印给没有泵用电网的现场。它们不是一台机器的两个名字。这一格照已印出的读：是。4100 是 1300 kg。

body.en: “Power plants – electrical "island" mode” is an outline label from “Diesel generator”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Keep this cell as published. Use the 4100 when the published rural window fits: 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, 40–100 m horizontal / 15–45 m vertical, aggregate 1–3 cm, slump 180–220 mm and 1300 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. It does not print the 4108 / 66 kW engine cell that belongs to Diesel 40. Read it in the Xingtai table. A 3 cm stone that fits the 4100 is not automatically a Diesel 40 stone. Taken from the printed row: Yes.
body.zh: “发电厂–电气“孤岛”模式”是《Diesel generator》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。这一格照已印出的读：4100 的表把功率标成 40 kW，并写成农村住宅用的拖拉机带动泵。它没有印属于柴油40的 4108 / 66 kW 发动机格。它印了坍落度 180–220 mm，柴油40没有。这些格子留在各自的页面上。旁边那一台不在这句话里。4100 印的是 15 MPa。柴油40印的是 25 MPa。

heading.zh: 支持主要公用事业电网

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Supporting main utility grids” from “Diesel generator”, then stays with the cells already published. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Use Diesel 40 when the off-grid line needs 26 m³/h and 120 m / 360 m on a 66 kW, 2800 kg trailer. Read it in the Xingtai table. It does print slump 180–220 mm, which Diesel 40 does not. Taken from the printed row: Say whether a tractor drive is what you have, or a trailer diesel. Keep this cell as published. The 4100 is 1300 kg.
body.zh: 本节保留《Diesel generator》的标题“支持主要公用事业电网”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。柴油40的介绍把 120 m / 360 m 和 1 cm 骨料写在一起，没有另加最大骨料规格格。4100 确实印了 1–3 cm。能放进 4100 的 3 cm 石子，不会自动变成柴油40的石子。按邢台表上的原文理解：/solutions/industrial-projects 点名了柴油30–120和拖拉机带动4100。

body.en: The section shape comes from “Cost of generating electricity” in “Diesel generator”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints both for sites without a pump-motor grid. Taken from the printed row: Keep those cells on their own pages. Keep this cell as published. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The 4100 prints 15 MPa.
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Diesel generator》的“发电成本”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：请说明你有的是拖拉机带动，还是拖式柴油机。

question.en: “Diesel generator set” does not change the check: Is Diesel 40’s weight 2800 kg?
question.zh: “柴油发电机组”不改这一问：柴油40的重量是 2800 kg 吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Yes. The 4100 is 1300 kg.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：是。4100 是 1300 kg。

question.en: Do they share 15 MPa, once the outline says “Generator size”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“发电机粒径”时，它们都是 15 MPa 吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: The 4100 prints 15 MPa. Diesel 40 prints 25 MPa.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：4100 印的是 15 MPa。柴油40印的是 25 MPa。

question.en: Under “Power plants – electrical "island" mode”, which solution page lists both?
question.zh: 在“发电厂–电气“孤岛”模式”这一节里，哪一页应用同时列出两者？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. /solutions/industrial-projects names Diesel 30–120 and the tractor-driven 4100.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：/solutions/industrial-projects 点名了柴油30–120和拖拉机带动4100。
